description: DBEngine.CreateDatabase in ACCDB format with each of 6 locale spellings (empty, LANGID only, LANGID with CP, no leading semicolon, English UK, neutral): reads CollatingOrder, builds T(ID, K) with six values (a, A, b, B, e-acute, e), index IX_K, reads SQL ORDER BY K, closes. Asks which spellings are accepted, which sort identifier each yields and whether the order differs; DBEngine.Errors is read at the end and every file image is kept.
